personality: 4 Tactile / Playful structure with 8 Hand-Drawn earthy palette
personality_one_liner: A warm, touchable, and slightly humorous industrial idle game with weathered earthy colors, chunky tactile buttons, and friendly progress feedback.

spacing.rule: Use chunky spacing for tactile game components. Ensure generous padding inside building cards and sticky bottoms for CTA.

do's: Avoid glassmorphism. Use solid tactile components with shadows to simulate chunky physical buttons, suiting the earthy/industrial vibe.
dont's: Do not use blur or glass effects, as they contrast with the raw, weathered, rusted metal aesthetic.

screens.name: Town HUD (Home)
screens.purpose: Displays top resource header (Scrap, Components, Finished Goods, Coins, XP) and scrollable illustrated list of building cards.

states.empty: No buildings available. Show a 'Clear the rubble' placeholder.
states.error: Failed to load save state. Show retry button.

screens.layout: Fixed sticky Resource Inventory Header at top (grid of 5 currencies with icons). A global progress bar right below it for 'Town Restoration'. Main scrollview contains large touch-friendly cards for 'Scrap Yard', 'Machine Shop', and 'Shipping Depot'. Use Skia for placeholder abstract illustrations on the cards. Bottom Tab bar.

screens.name: Building Details (Bottom Sheet)
screens.purpose: Contextual panel for upgrading and interacting with a specific building (e.g. Scrap Yard production loop).
screens.layout: Gorhom bottom sheet popping up when a building card is pressed. Contains large animated progress bars for production timers. A huge primary 'Collect' or 'Start Job' CTA pinned to the bottom. Shows level up cost in large numbers.

screens.name: Shipping Depot (Contracts)
screens.purpose: Contract board for fulfilling orders and earning coins + XP.

states.empty: No current contracts. 'Wait for next shipment' illustration.

screens.layout: 3 horizontal or grid cards showing requested items vs inventory items. Large 'Fulfill' button on each. Pinned header with current Coins.

screens.name: Welcome Back (Offline Summary)
screens.purpose: Modal overlay displayed upon app launch summarizing offline production.
screens.layout: Centered modal card over an overlay. Shows 'While you were away...' title, a list of collected Scrap and Components, and a big 'Claim' CTA at the bottom.

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the 4 Tactile / Playful structure for component shapes: use large tappable areas, chunky cards, pill-shaped or rounded CTAs (radius lg/pill), and distinct shadow tier 2 to make buttons feel physical.
Do NOT use glassmorphism. This app requires a solid, matte, touch-friendly UI that fits the physical, raw, weathered industrial aesthetic.
Color Palette: Heavily rely on the primary rust (#D95A21) and safety warning yellow (#F2B84B) against the warm clay off-white surface. Ensure high contrast for all numbers and resources.
Typography: Use Fredoka for bouncy, friendly, heavy headings, and Nunito for highly readable, rounded body text. Never use heavy font weights above 500.

Layout: The top HUD must be omnipresent (absolute positioned or fixed layout at the top, respecting SafeArea) showing all 5 currencies with icons. Building cards should use Skia for simple, textured, geometric illustrations of factories since we must use placeholder art.

Interaction: Add haptics to all major verbs ('Collect', 'Start Job', 'Fulfill Contract'). Create bouncy reanimated scale transformations (spring) when building cards are pressed or progress bars complete.
Use Phosphor icons. Provide filled versions for active states or collected resources, and outlined versions for empty/inactive states.
